translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

book.name: 1 Timoteo
book.title: Pablo Kepegin Timoteoga Karta Palmijad 1 Timoteo

content: Imi antin pega chogzhundo, pemal Pabzhe kolenabmal, Pabzhe immal ekisenabmal, tegin pe Pabzhe wilegenabmal, tegin pe tule-pidga Pabzhe wilegenabmalbal, tegin pe Pabga tog-nuedi chogenabmalbal. Tenal pemalgabi pe melle Pabzhe kolmalo, tenal pe erreymalga, tegin tule-tummagan-pimaladga, tegin pe tulemalga-pel-kwapa pe Pabzhe kolmalo:
anmal nued ampagumalgal tegin anmal Pabgin-atagedgin tegin chwilidikidgin nanemalgal.
Tenal an-pega-chogzhadyob pe Pabzhe kolel, wedin ib-nueddo. Tenal Pab-anmal-abonoged, ampa yer itomogo.
Tenal Pabdin peiendo, tulemal pel-kwapa abonole, tegin tulemal-pel-kwapa igal-chunchunnad wisgumalbal.
Imi Pab Tummadbi walkwénna mai, Pab Tummad ukin pid pal nikchul. Tegin tule-irwal-Pab-Tummadbak-chunmaked walkwénna maibal. Tenal we tuledin, Jesucristo.
Tenal Jesucristo pel-kwapa anmal-anal aga chan ukcha purkwegal. Tenal Jesúsga e-wilubganbal pél immal kus. Al tulemal mag taknonimal Pab Tummad pei tulemal-pel-kwapa Jesúsbal abonole.

Al an nugzhalenonijundo, an Pab-kaka-palchogedga kugal, tegin an Jesús-nuggin-palmilegalidga kugalbal. Tenal an chunchunnad chunma, an kwen kakanzhejul. Tegin an nugzhalenonibal, igal-chunchunnadgin tule-Judiojulmalad-oturdagal, tegin tulemal melle Pab-Jesúsgin pengumalgal.

Imi antin, an pei, machergan meke-pia Pabzhe kolalmalal, melle urwedgin, tegin melle aga abin-abin imakedgin Pabzhe kolmalo. Tenal machergan aga ulubgin-chwilidik-itogedgin igal-mamikidbal chunkal-aktoedgin Pabzhe kolenabmal.

Imi an peibal, omegan melle twagdar-peyedzhe mol-nuegan yoo, nuekwagwadgin mol yoenabmal. Tenal omegan melle twagdar-wilub-okpis chagla-nudakedgin nanemalo, tegin omegan melle twagdar-nue ol nazhimalo, tegin omegan melle twagdar-nue win-karked nazhimalbalo, tegin omegan melle twagdar-peyedzhe mol-karked yomalo, tegin omegan melle twagdar-wilub-okpis nudamalo tulemal pinche nugu e-takegalbi. Tenal ome-nuegan aga wilub-pallí nudamal.
Tenal omegan po-ampaguedgin Pab-igalgin turdakenabmal, tegin tule-tummagan-ulpallí-naneedgin turdakenabmalbal.

Tenal antin omeganga igal-kwen-ukchulbal, pulaledgin Pab-igalbal tulemal-oturdagal. Tenal an omeganga igal-kwen-ukchulbal, omegan macherganga pul tummarba itomalgal, tenal omegan yakiri ampaguenabmal.
Imi Pab Tummad Adán-inzhel-opinnis, tegin Pab kep te-cholbal Eva-opinninonimo.
Tenal Adán kwen yardaleszhul, tenal e-ome-Evadin yardalesdo. Al Eva iskuedgin arkwas. Al omegan keg kujun, machergan-pir-pirgin nanegal.
Tenal omegan Pabgin-penzhul natapil, tegin tulemal-pilalbalil, tegin Pab-peigujiidyob nanebalil, tegin ome aga otummojulil, tenal wilubbal nanebalil, we omegan aga nan-itogedgin, abonolego.
